item.title: AI Threat Modelling for Cybersecurity Engineers: When the Assistant Trusts the Wrong Document
item.description:
AI Threat Modelling for Cybersecurity Engineers: When the Assistant Trusts the Wrong Document

You already know how to threat-model a web application, API or identity system.

You know to ask:

Who can change this data?
Who can read it?
Which identity is being used?
What happens if this trust boundary fails?

Those questions still matter when artificial intelligence is involved.
